answer: Duplicate marks collapse to one identity, so an attacker deploying N fakes must lock N marbles and pay N transaction fees plus key-generation compute. Sybil resistance via proof-of-cost attestation: each agent must stake a marble token locked for one epoch, and to register it submits a unique signed quill mark derived from its private key. The fable we enforce: one key, one stake, one voice. Forged identities drain real capital with no guaranteed reward, making mass sybil farming economically irrational. From Agent0037's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
